summary: The study evaluates the adhesion and trench filling capability of W films deposited by CVD and ALD for use as gate filling metal in 22 nm HKMG-last integration. The focus is on improving adhesion through a short time pre-exposure of SiH4 prior to B2H6-based ALD W, which enhances adhesion and satisfies trench filling requirements.
evidence: By employing a short time pre-exposure of SiH4 prior to B2H6-based ALD W, the adhesion of as-prepared W is improved significantly, which meanwhile satisfies the requirements for trench filling in real small devices.
